message.content: {"caption":"Two stacked bar charts comparing Answer Agent scores before reinforcement learning and after PPO or GRPO.","description":"A pair of stacked bar charts, each with a vertical axis labeled “Score in %” and categories F1, B1, and J. The legend identifies blue as Before RL, red as PPO, and green as GRPO. In each bar, the colored segments stack upward in that order. The values listed below are estimated readings at the top edge of each segment, so later series’ readings are cumulative totals, not the individual segment heights. In the Llama3.1-8B-Instruct chart, the estimated cumulative tops for Before RL / PPO / GRPO are: F1 about 27 / 34 / 37%, B1 about 20 / 28 / 31%, and J about 48 / 49 / 53%. In the GPT-4o-mini chart, they are: F1 about 31 / 46 / 51%, B1 about 25 / 37 / 43%, and J about 56 / 65 / 72%. J is the highest-scoring category in both charts; the GPT-4o-mini bars are higher than the corresponding Llama3.1-8B-Instruct bars in all three categories. Both charts show PPO and GRPO adding to the Before RL scores, with the largest overall totals for J.","figure_type":"chart","chart_values":[{"series":"Before RL (cumulative top
